an3.70:16.6: Those deities who were endowed with such ethics, when they passed away from here, were reborn there; and such ethics are found in me too.
an3.70:16.7: Those deities who were endowed with such learning, when they passed away from here, were reborn there; and such learning is found in me too.
an3.70:16.8: Those deities who were endowed with such generosity, when they passed away from here, were reborn there; and such generosity is found in me too.
an3.70:16.9: Those deities who were endowed with such wisdom, when they passed away from here, were reborn there; and such wisdom is found in me too.’
an3.70:18.8: With such wisdom, when they passed away from here, were reborn there; and such wisdom is found in me too.’
an3.70:41.1: the Jains and perils, and Venāgapura;
an3.70:41.2: Sarabha and the Kālāmas of Kesamutta;
an3.70:41.4: the root of the Jains and the sabbath.
